description: Create the complete Halo 2.x custom theme 'theme-engineering-company' with all templates, CSS, and JS. The theme is designed for a water conservancy engineering company (水利工程公司) with a professional, authoritative style.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/company-home/theme-engineering-company/theme.yaml - Halo 2.x theme manifest with apiVersion: theme.halo.run/v1alpha1, kind: Theme, metadata (name: theme-engineering-company), spec (displayName: 水利工程企业官网主题, author, website, description, logo, version: 1.0.0, requires: '>=2.0.0').

Create /projects/sandbox/company-home/theme-engineering-company/settings.yaml - Theme settings definition with groups for: basic settings (company name, logo URL, slogan, ICP备案号), contact info (address, phone, email, fax), social media links, SEO settings (keywords, description), color customization options.

Create /projects/sandbox/company-home/theme-engineering-company/templates/modules/header.html - Thymeleaf fragment with: top bar (phone, email), main navigation with logo and menu items (首页, 关于我们, 业务领域, 工程案例, 新闻中心, 联系我们). Use th:fragment, th:href, responsive hamburger menu for mobile.

Create /projects/sandbox/company-home/theme-engineering-company/templates/modules/footer.html - Thymeleaf fragment with: 4-column layout (company intro brief, quick links, business areas, contact info), bottom copyright bar with ICP备案号. Use th:fragment.

Create /projects/sandbox/company-home/theme-engineering-company/templates/index.html - Full homepage template including: (1) Banner carousel with water conservancy project images and slogans like '专注水利 造福民生', (2) Company introduction summary with read-more link, (3) Core business display with icons - 水库大坝工程, 河道治理工程, 农田灌溉工程, 防洪排涝工程, 水土保持工程, 供水工程, (4) Achievement numbers - 完工项目500+, 服务年限20+, 团队规模300+, 合作客户200+, (5) Featured project cases as image cards, (6) Latest news section pulling from Halo posts, (7) Partner logos section, (8) Include header and footer modules.

Create /projects/sandbox/company-home/theme-engineering-company/templates/page.html - Generic page template for custom Halo pages (about us, business areas, contact). Uses Thymeleaf th:utext for content rendering, includes breadcrumb navigation, sidebar optional.

Create /projects/sandbox/company-home/theme-engineering-company/templates/post.html - Article detail page template for news articles. Includes: breadcrumb, title, publish date, category, content body, previous/next navigation, related posts.

Create /projects/sandbox/company-home/theme-engineering-company/templates/archives.html - News center / article list page. Shows articles in a list with thumbnail, title, excerpt, date. Includes category/tag filtering sidebar and pagination.
Create /projects/sandbox/company-home/theme-engineering-company/templates/categories.html - Category listing page showing all post categories with article counts.
Create /projects/sandbox/company-home/theme-engineering-company/templates/tags.html - Tag cloud page showing all tags.

Create /projects/sandbox/company-home/theme-engineering-company/assets/css/style.css - Complete responsive CSS (1200+ lines) with: CSS variables for theming (--primary: #1a5276, --primary-light: #2980b9, --accent: #e67e22, --water-blue: #1abc9c), reset/base styles, typography (system fonts with 思源黑体), header/nav styles with dropdown, hero banner/carousel, section layouts, card components, timeline component (for company history), counter/stats animation styles, grid system, footer styles, responsive breakpoints (1200px, 992px, 768px, 576px), utility classes, form styles, breadcrumb styles, pagination styles, animation keyframes.

Create /projects/sandbox/company-home/theme-engineering-company/assets/js/main.js - JavaScript for: mobile nav toggle, banner carousel auto-play and manual controls, scroll-triggered counter animation for stats section, smooth scroll for anchor links, back-to-top button, lazy image loading placeholder, active nav highlighting based on current page.

Create /projects/sandbox/company-home/theme-engineering-company/README.md - Theme documentation in Chinese explaining: theme features, installation steps (upload to Halo), configuration options from settings.yaml, page template usage, customization tips.
acceptance_criteria: theme.yaml is valid YAML following Halo 2.x theme spec with correct apiVersion and kind
settings.yaml defines configurable options with proper Halo settings schema
All 6 template files exist in templates/ and use proper Thymeleaf syntax (th:each, th:text, th:href, th:fragment, th:replace)
header.html and footer.html exist in templates/modules/ as Thymeleaf fragments
style.css is comprehensive (1000+ lines) with responsive design, CSS variables, and all component styles
main.js provides carousel, counter animation, mobile nav, and scroll behaviors
All templates properly include header and footer fragments
Theme README.md provides installation and usage instructions
verification: Verify all theme files exist in the expected directory structure
Validate theme.yaml and settings.yaml are valid YAML
Verify style.css contains responsive media queries and CSS custom properties
Verify templates use Thymeleaf syntax correctly (th: attributes present)
findings: All 13 theme files created successfully. theme.yaml and settings.yaml validated as valid YAML using Ruby parser. CSS is 2052 lines with responsive breakpoints at 1200px, 992px, 768px, and 576px. All templates contain proper Thymeleaf syntax (th:fragment, th:replace, th:each, th:text, th:href, th:utext, th:if). JS includes carousel with auto-play, IntersectionObserver-based counter animation, mobile nav toggle, sticky header, back-to-top button, active nav highlighting, and lazy image loading.
